why: First day on Lecture 12, plus one review question.

primer.h: Pulling cargo into the cell (receptor-mediated endocytosis)
primer.body: Particles stick to receptors on the surface; an adaptor reads a signal on the receptor's tail and recruits a coat that bends the membrane into a pit (Lecture 12, slides 8-9).

questions.text: Name the adaptor and the coat in receptor-mediated endocytosis, and say what each one does.

key.mechanism: The adaptor (AP2) binds the sorting signal on the receptor's cytosolic tail and recruits the coat (clathrin); clathrin subunits assemble into a curved cage that bends the membrane into a coated pit, which pinches off as a vesicle.
mustHave: AP2 reads the receptor's tail signal
